items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. I've heard of him, but I never remember seeing him.

ctx.x: Yeah. I've heard of him, but I never remember seeing him.
You remember them, Shane? You say you do, huh?
I remember them well. They copied behind us. We were the first band, Memphis Jug Band, ever started Jug Band in Memphis, Tennessee. I am.
